In this era we gathered first around the address. Seventy-two of us said "state of the union" by 2024-03-07, and sixty-six said "state of the union address" the same day. Thirty-five of us said "biden’s state of the union," thirty said "biden’s state of the union address," all peaking on 2024-03-07. John Barrasso first said "state of the union," on 2013-01-20.

By 2024-03-13 we moved together again. Thirty-one of us said "protecting americans from foreign," twenty-nine said "protecting americans from foreign adversary controlled," and twenty-nine said "the protecting americans from foreign." Thirty of us said "the chinese communist," which Chuck Grassley first said on 2013-03-22. We report the record.
